summary: P2 customer-approval-stamp bug fix VERIFIED end-to-end on preview (stamp-approval-flow.preview.emergentagent.com, DB_PROVIDER=supabase). Backend: 3/3 pytest passes — (1) POST /api/approvals + public/{token}/respond with OTP now surfaces the approved row in GET /api/vehicles/{id}/approval-logs (Supabase branch of routes_approvals.py maps approval_requests → camelCase with responderName + respondedAt); (2) GET /api/customers/{id}/approval-logs parity endpoint returns the same shape (verified via list containment for created token); (3) template resolution regression — /api/document-templates/resolve returns unified-invoice-a4-mobile-v1, unified-diagnosis-a4-mobile-v1, unified-quote-a4-mobile-v1 as tenant defaults (defaults NOT polluted). Frontend UI on /print?vehicleId=…&docType=invoice: POSITIVE case (vehicle c02cc9c7-6ff5-4fc7-9414-b15787fa9000, سلطان الشاص, plate 6923 ب ح ن) — after creating + OTP-approving APR-0456AC2E, the invoice preview iframe renders a GREEN circular stamp with 'تمت الموافقة' + responder name in the 'اعتماد العميل' section while 'اعتماد الورشة' stays EMPTY (screenshot iter303_print_positive.png). NEGATIVE case (vehicle a7dbd9dd, no approvals) — both approval sections are EMPTY, no 'تمت الموافقة' text, no raw {{CUSTOMER_APPROVAL_STAMP}} placeholder leaked into the preview iframe (screenshot iter303_print_negative.png). critical_code_review_comments: routes_approvals.py — the Mongo branch of get_vehicle_approval_logs / get_customer_approval_logs still reads from `customer_approval_logs` collection, which is DIFFERENT from the `approval_requests` collection where Mongo POST /approvals actually writes (see line 225: `db.approval_requests.insert_one(doc)`). In pure Mongo mode this endpoint would also return [] unless code elsewhere mirrors approval_requests into customer_approval_logs. Not a regression for the current fix (preview is Supabase), but worth confirming before promoting to production if any Mongo tenant exists.

Mongo cleanup gap: there is no DELETE /api/approvals/{id} endpoint (also flagged iter301/302); testers must reach into the Supabase (or Mongo) client directly, which is fragile in CI. Consider adding an admin-only DELETE for test hygiene.

OTP is returned in the POST /api/approvals response body — convenient for tests but potentially unsafe in production if the endpoint is ever exposed to a lower-trust role. Confirm that only workshop-admin can call POST /api/approvals.

For a fresh negative-case vehicle, filter GET /api/vehicles for approval-logs length==0 (see the small selector in this iteration's log).
rca of the issue: GET /api/vehicles/{id}/approval-logs (and the customer variant) previously only queried Mongo collection `customer_approval_logs`. In Supabase mode POST /api/approvals/public/{token}/respond writes to Supabase table `approval_requests` and never touches `customer_approval_logs`, so DocumentPrint.loadApprovalLogs() (frontend) always saw []. Fix in routes_approvals.py adds a provider gate: when DB_PROVIDER=supabase both endpoints query approval_requests filtered by vehicle_id/customer_id and map snake_case columns → camelCase (id, token, vehicleId, customerId, status, respondedAt, responderName, responderPhone) via _map_supabase_approval_row so the existing frontend normalizeApproval / approvalStamp builder recognises status='approved' and renders the green ختم. Verified positive + negative cases both work.
